items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: So he and I got a ride from Muskogee to Nashville, Tennessee with his uncle.

ctx.x: Scholarships. So I wrote and told them I wanted to go to that college. So they said, 'If you want to go, we'll give you a scholarship that will take care of so much of your expense. But you'll have to come up with so much,' you know? So this fella named Jesse Culbertson and myself, we had both written there. So he had a scholarship and I had a scholarship.
What was the other guy's name?
